description: Measured changes of one Swiss glacier: front variation per survey interval (m) with cumulative retreat, annual/winter/summer mass balance (mm water equivalent) with ELA, and geodetic volume change (km³, mean thickness change). Give a name or SGI id. Example: {glacier: 'Rhonegletscher'}, {glacier: 'B43-03', series: 'length'}.

glacier.description: Glacier name (or part) or SGI id from list_glaciers

last.description: Most recent N observations per series

name: get_glacier_changes
